about_motion: Motion goldens (quality plan item 15 (b)): 12 frames in a row of a regress fixture's key move, cropped to box (1080x1920 px), drawn with main and now and compared frame by frame by SSIM. A change in timing, an arc or a pop shows even when every single still looks fine.
